nodes.description: Public mapping(string => uint256) storing packed value/timestamp pairs.
Address authorized to update oracle values and itself; access-control pivot.
Updates packed value/timestamp for a key; guarded by require(msg.sender == oracleUpdater).
View function unpacking stored uint256 into (value, timestamp).
Rotates the oracleUpdater address; guarded by require(msg.sender == oracleUpdater).
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and constructor initialization.
Bit-shift and addition packing (((uint256)value) << 128) + timestamp in setValue.
Modulo and right-shift unpacking cValue % 2**128 and cValue >> 128 in getValue.
String key parameter of setValue used to index values mapping.
uint128 oracle value parameter of setValue packed into the high 128 bits.
uint128 timestamp parameter of setValue packed into the low 128 bits.
String key parameter of getValue used to read values mapping.
address parameter of updateOracleUpdaterAddress assigned to oracleUpdater.
Packed uint256 result of the shift/add expression in setValue.
Raw uint256 read from values mapping in getValue.
Low 128 bits extracted as timestamp in getValue.
High 128 bits extracted as value in getValue.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored into oracleUpdater in the constructor, granting the deployer privileged control.
Constructor executes with the untrusted msg.sender as the initial privileged account.
msg.sender is compared against oracleUpdater, gating entry to setValue.
msg.sender is compared against oracleUpdater, gating entry to updateOracleUpdaterAddress.
setValue reads oracleUpdater to authorize the caller.
updateOracleUpdaterAddress writes the new privileged address into oracleUpdater.
Parameter newOracleUpdaterAddress is assigned to the oracleUpdater state variable.
Value parameter flows into the left shift of the packing expression.
Timestamp parameter flows into the addition of the packing expression.
setValue executes the shift/add packing computation.
Key parameter selects the storage slot written in the values mapping.
Packed arithmetic result is stored into the values mapping.
setValue writes the packed value into the values mapping.
Stored uint256 is read and fed into the modulo/shift unpacking computation.
getValue executes the modulo and right-shift unpacking operations.
Key parameter selects the storage slot read from the values mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Key parameter only serves to index the mapping inside setValue and has no independent security role.
Value parameter is consumed directly by the packing unsafe operation.
Timestamp parameter is consumed directly by the packing unsafe operation.
Key parameter only serves to index the mapping read inside getValue.
New oracle updater parameter is written to state only through updateOracleUpdaterAddress.
Local cValue is the direct result of the shift/add unsafe operation in setValue.
Local cValue is the direct input of the unpacking unsafe operation in getValue.
Local timestamp is produced by the modulo operation in getValue.
Local value is produced by the right-shift operation in getValue.
